name: Mert Ali ERENTÜRK
about: I'm Mert Ali ERENTÜRK, a Data & AI Engineer. I work on data pipelines, lakehouse design and LLM applications.
I'm also working on mobile apps and LangGraph workflows. I care about where the data comes from, what happens when a job fails, and how to check an AI output.

capabilities.title: Lakehouse Architecture
capabilities.description: Raw, cleaned and serving layers, with clear rules for how data moves between them. Schema changes, table layout and data quality checks are the main design decisions.

capabilities.title: Big Data Ecosystems & Data Platforms
capabilities.description: How storage, distributed compute and orchestration fit together. Choosing batch or streaming based on the workload, rather than adding infrastructure by default.

capabilities.title: Data Flows & Orchestration
capabilities.description: Dependencies, incremental loads, retries and backfills. I pay particular attention to whether a failed run can be repeated without duplicating data.

capabilities.title: System Design
capabilities.description: API boundaries, events and shared state between services. Keeping interfaces clear enough that one component can change without forcing changes everywhere else.

capabilities.title: AI Pipeline Design
capabilities.description: Taking data through preparation, retrieval or inference, then evaluation. Recording which inputs, prompts and models produced a result makes debugging possible.

capabilities.title: LLM Application Architectures
capabilities.description: Retrieval, context assembly, tool calls and structured responses. Testing what the application should do when context is missing or a model gives an unusable answer.

capabilities.title: LangGraph Agent Workflows
capabilities.description: State, routing and tool use in multi-step agent flows. Checkpoints and human review define where a workflow can pause, resume or ask for help.

focus.title: Mobile Application Development
focus.description: Mobile interfaces, application state and API integration. I'm interested in how the client handles authentication, loading and failed requests.

focus.title: AI Pipelines & Agent Workflows
focus.description: Connecting retrieval and tool calls into repeatable workflows, then checking the outputs. LangGraph is part of this work.

focus.title: Data Engineering Concepts
focus.description: Lakehouse layouts, data models and batch or streaming jobs. Understanding when incremental processing helps and how to recover after a failed run.
